bataille.title: Goal
bataille.text: Win all the cards of the other player.

bataille.title: Deal
bataille.text: The cards are shuffled and split into two equal piles, face down. With fewer than 52 cards, the highest ones are kept: with 32 cards, from 7 to ace.

bataille.title: A round
bataille.text: Each player taps their pile to turn over its top card. The higher card wins both cards, which go to that player's won pile. The ace is the highest, then the king, queen, jack, 10, and so on down to the 2.

bataille.title: Battle
bataille.text: When both cards have the same value, it is a battle: each player lays one card face down, then one card face up. The higher card wins all the cards laid. If they are equal again, the battle goes on.

bataille.title: End of the game
bataille.text: When a pile is empty, the player takes back the cards they won. The player with no card left loses. If both players run out at the same time, the game is a tie.

spider.title: Goal
spider.text: Arrange all the cards into complete sequences, from king down to ace, of the same suit. A complete sequence leaves the table. The game is won when no card is left.

spider.title: Moving
spider.text: A card goes on a card one rank higher, whatever its suit: a 6 on a 7. Several cards move together only if they follow each other in the same suit. A face-down card left at the bottom of a column is turned over.

spider.title: Empty column
spider.text: Any card, or run of cards that follow each other, can go to an empty column.

spider.title: Stock
spider.text: Tapping the stock deals one card on each column. This cannot be done while a column is empty.

spider.title: Suits
spider.text: With 1 suit, all cards are spades. With 2 or 4 suits, sequences are harder to build.

spider.title: Number of cards
spider.text: 104 cards: 2 decks on 10 columns, 8 sequences to build. 52 cards: 1 deck on 8 columns, 4 sequences to build.

spider.title: Help
spider.text: The light bulb suggests a move, and each new press suggests another one. The arrow undoes the last move. The game is saved after every move.
